title: The Role of Hormones in Postpartum Mood Disorders
brief_summary: The present protocol is designed to create a "scaled-down" hormonal milieu of pregnancy and the puerperium in order to determine whether it is the abrupt withdrawal of gonadal steroids or the prolonged exposure to gonadal steroids that is associated with mood symptoms.
line_of_therapy_overall_summary: This is not an oncology trial and does not involve systemic therapy for advanced disease. The study focuses on hormonal manipulation in women with and without histories of mood disorders, with no reference to cancer treatment or lines of therapy.

cohort_line_of_therapy.cohort_label: Group 1: Women with a history of postpartum depression
cohort_line_of_therapy.line_of_therapy_text: This cohort includes women with a history of postpartum depression but does not reference any cancer diagnosis or systemic therapy for advanced disease. No line-of-therapy intent is applicable.

cohort_line_of_therapy.cohort_label: Group 2: Women with a history of Major Depressive Disorder
cohort_line_of_therapy.line_of_therapy_text: This cohort includes women with a history of major depressive disorder outside the postpartum period, with no mention of cancer or systemic therapy. Line-of-therapy intent is not applicable.
